title: Decide the library-product workflow outcome
description: A named human reviews persisted typed analytics and records promote, reject, extend, or redesign. Extend is an interim receipt and does not complete this decision Bead; a terminal outcome stops exposure and defines—but does not execute—the surviving behavior and cleanup obligations. The feature cannot close while temporary selection, a losing executable branch, an active exposure, or an unreconciled lease remains.
design: Decision authority is human and product-scoped. Promote selects treatment; reject retains control. Extend stops exposure and revokes the old delivery.execute, feature.policy.write, feature.exposure.execute, rollback.execute, credential.use, network.connect, push, and publish leases, creates a new bounded experiment and analytics child cycle with new independent owner decisions and expiry, and leaves this Bead open. Redesign opens a successor parent request and must also reject or explicitly retire the current candidate before this Bead can close. Only a terminal outcome creates a new cleanup snapshot and boundary authority; no legacy VMR or old lease can be reused.
acceptanceCriteria: Every receipt cites the persisted analytics and exposure decision. An extend receipt revokes the prior delivery/exposure leases, records a new bounded window and guardrails, adds a new experiment/analytics child cycle, and does not satisfy this Bead's blocking dependency or unblock removal. Redesign opens a successor parent and records the current candidate's terminal rejection or retirement. Only terminal promote, reject, or redesign-with-current-candidate-disposition closes this Bead, stops exposure, preserves all evidence, and requires a new digest-bound cleanup snapshot, repository-owner delegation, shard, and lease before cleanup source work. The feature remains open until cleanup, validation, persistence, operational retirement, revocation, and governance closure complete.
notes: Extend is never indefinite exposure and never falls through to cleanup as a completed decision. Redesign cannot reuse the prior accepted snapshot as source authorization when change units differ.
